game: Pump It Up NX: New Xenesis
approach: Faithful C reconstruction of the Linux arcade executable piu (ELF i386), no emulation, native SDL2 + OpenGL.
notes: Attract loop, all four stations (TRAINING / ARCADE / WORLD TOUR / SPECIAL ZONE), NX Mode and modifiers, Stage Break, kcal screen, name entry and NX service menu work. Internet Ranking is turned off on purpose.
